At home tonight — the Square: Odette, Constance; the Market: Jory, Dorian, Agnes; the Docks: Hollis, Isolde, Lian; Chapel Hill: Greta.

=== Day 2: the town meeting ===
Hollis: "So that the record is free of ambiguity on this point: I am the Gravedigger."
Hollis: "Last night, I learned that Edda, whom we hanged, was the Revenant."  [case board: #60, #61]
Constance: "I should mention: Last night, I watched the Market: I saw Odette out."
Constance: "I must voice my misgivings regarding Odette; their conduct troubles me."  [case board: #62, #63]
Odette: "If anyone is keeping score, I don't trust Constance. I saw them out in the street from my window last night."  [case board: #64, #65]
Jory: "Okay, maybe it's just a hunch, guys, something feels super off with Greta!"  [case board: #31]
Greta: "I'll put my cards on the table so the rest of you stop squinting at me: I am the Dowser."
Greta: "On day 1, in the afternoon, on the Square I sensed 3 evil among Jory, Dorian, Odette, Lian."
Greta: "This morning, on the Market I sensed 3 evil among Hollis, Odette, Constance, Isolde."  [case board: #66, #67, #68]
Dorian: "Sorry to pile on, but I actually agree with Constance about Odette."  [case board: #69]
Isolde: "Please hear me gently, everyone—I only held back out of fear, but I am the Lamplighter."
Isolde: "The night before you arrived, walking the lamps, I counted 1 other out."
Isolde: "Last night, walking the lamps, I counted 2 others out."
Isolde: "It pains me, truly, but I share Constance's fear about Odette."  [case board: #70, #71, #72, #73]
Lian: "Here's what the town needs to know to narrow the list: I am the Martyr."
Lian: "Last night, I have given my life over for Isolde, should the town ever hang them."
Lian: "I back Constance's read on Odette."  [case board: #74, #75, #76]

Constance: "Greta's testimony spans a number of us. My own hands are clean; let your scrutiny fall on the others it names."
